ui-spin-icon: no rule on the element itself: the animation is declared on `.ui-spin-icon > svg`, which a same-element comparison cannot observe
ui-status-badge-success: removed from the markup on 2026-10-31: it had no CSS rule at all (dead class). Re-add together with a real rule if the "current" badge should be emphasised.
ui-embedded: structural marker with no CSS rule; used to scope embedded layouts in markup only
ui-grimoire: root marker with no CSS rule; theming goes through data attributes, not this class
ui-settings-scroll: scroll container marker with no CSS rule; scrolling behaviour comes from utility classes
